checks.evidence: Read all seven lessons in full. Each has essential question, 3 or 4 observable goals, bridge, instruction, worked example, practice with answers, four answered diagnostics, claim scope and next dependency. All 28 required E/W/P/D IDs and all three legacy C12-EIG IDs are present.

Compared every lesson teaching_anchor with actual content. Row action precedes eigenpairs; square roots precede path derivation; dot product and norm precede reconstruction; product entries and neighbor sums precede multiplicities; composition and inverse precede intertwiner tests. Two-case path proof explicitly justifies nonzero divisions. No general spectral theorem is assessed.

Hand-recomputed row sums and all diagnostic answers; recomputed norms 2,sqrt(2),2, normalization and mutual dot products; checked center product value -sqrt(2)/4 and neighbor sum -1/2; corner value 1/(4sqrt(2)) and neighbor sum -1/2. Computational corroboration is independent-computation.json, generated by independent_check.py in tf_gpu_env.

Enumerated all 27 product choices and checked all 729 pairwise dot products numerically. Fresh multiplicities are 1,3,6,7,6,3,1; fresh degree histogram is {3:8,4:12,5:6,6:1}. Every eigenpair component agrees within 1e-12, maximum discrepancy 2.220446049250313e-16; exact symbolic reasoning was separately checked in lessons.

Recomputed mode reconstruction for (1,2,3) and (2,0,0), their residuals, even/odd parts, means and centered details. All reconstruct exactly algebraically. 13 antipodal pairs and center give 14 even/13 odd dimensions; retaining mean gives 1+13+13. Chi node counts instead give 13 positive/14 negative. Constant-line noninvariance correctly blocks an inherited quotient adjacency.

Verified swap composition BT=TA=[[0,2],[1,0]], identity failure diag(1,-1), listed numerical route examples, and reflection/adjacency commutation using the neighbor bijection. B_Y is explicitly distinguished from geometric B.

Read exact S02 /backbone_sequence/7, /backbone_sequence/2/sheet_populations and /backbone_sequence/16. All five supplied source hashes match. Independently reduced the actual 13x6 M17 channel matrix with rational arithmetic, obtaining rank 6. Source-reported claims, synthetic examples and fresh finite derivations remain distinguished. No physical mechanism is asserted from count matches.

Compared all seven capstone required-operation entries with earlier actual explanations and answered practice. Every requested operation has a taught route, including mean guard, chi/function parity distinction and failed identity intertwiner. Subsequently read completed capstone.md in full: its actual seven questions, complete worked answers and backward map preserve that closure.

Recomputed the capstone answer key and each rubric subtotal. Section totals 8+10+18+12+18+20+14=100. The exhaustive grouped mode rule counts every mode correctly; row, normalization, product-neighbor, reconstruction, mean/parity and intertwiner answers agree with independent checks. Every assessed operation has earlier instruction and answered practice or diagnostic rehearsal; no new mathematics is introduced in the assessment.

Read teacher-guide.md, course-map.md and terminology.md in full. Eleven core periods plus two capstone periods equal 715 minutes; each core allocation 5+20+15+15=55. Dense lessons 03-06 are split into two periods. Dependency repair gates align with units and actual lessons. Glossary preserves source/classroom B distinction, eigenvalue versus sheet label and reflection versus chi. Source scope and recognition-only decoder boundary are consistent.

Read sources.md and verify.py/verification.json. Source pointers for core M08, node sheets and M17 match directly inspected archival objects; exact source digests agree with independent source hashes. The manager checker correctly implements rational a+b sqrt(2) addition/multiplication and exact comparisons of all product eigenpairs and dot products; its reported passed 115 checks are corroborative of the separately executed independent float and rational-rank audit, not relabeled as this auditor's execution. Sources honestly distinguish local exact derivations from unresolved global DAG and formal retrieval scope. Graph search/get history is manager-reported, not independently replayed here.
